about_the_game:
Human and Zombie "is a post apocalyptic survival game that currently only supports single player gameplay. The difficulty of survival in the game is relatively difficult, and its feature is the story of surviving in the extremely impoverished and resource poor post apocalyptic world.

The game covers virus systems, satiety systems, weapon systems,

Wait, you have to survive!

——Virus system——

As the game time increases, your virus infection will also increase. When infected with 100%, you will completely become a zombie! Search for supplies and suppress them!

——Satiety system——

You may feel hungry and thirsty, but there are still various food resources left in the city! When you were extremely hungry or thirsty in the past, your health would decrease with game time!

——Weapon system——

You will have 3 types of weapons that can be used, pay attention to their durability and remaining quantity. Otherwise, you will not be able to survive. Of course, you can find them in the city.

——Day night system——

At night, the places you can see are minimal, increasing the difficulty of your search, but nothing can stop you from living. The dawn of the next day is still beautiful.

Conclusion:

This game was developed by the three of us over a period of 3 years, and the funds are no longer sufficient to fully complete it. Therefore, we are now releasing a playable version to provide project support for this game until the entire game is completed.

So please don't have high expectations for this game right now.

Of course, we hope to have more players play our game to support us in creating even better games and 3A masterpieces in the future.

content_descriptors.notes: The content contained in this game may not be suitable for all ages, or should not be accessed during work: frequent violence or blood, common adult content
